title: Nvidia’s Vera chip is the US$200 billion bet Jensen Huang doesn’t want you to overlook
summary: Nvidia's Vera chip is highlighted as an often overlooked but strategically important $200 billion market opportunity, overshadowed by Nvidia's impressive Q1 earnings of $81.62 billion and Q2 guidance of $91 billion that exceeded analyst expectations.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing demand for specialized AI computing chips beyond traditional GPUs, capturing new market segments in AI infrastructure.
why_valuable: Represents Nvidia's strategic diversification into a $200 billion market opportunity beyond its dominant GPU business, positioning the company for continued AI dominance.
